description: A 2.5km mountain bike flow trail/pump track through the forest.
directions: Turning off Nanaimo Parkway head west onto Jingle Pot Rd then take your first right onto Biggs Rd. Continue approx. 3.4km, the road then becomes Weigles Rd and the trail head is approx 2.4km further.
title: Fine China Mtn. Bike Trails
